Frequently Asked Questions

Every project includes discovery and art direction, custom page design, responsive layouts for mobile, tablet and desktop, and a Framer build with animations, CMS setup and basic SEO — so the site is ready to launch, not just designed.

A landing page usually takes 1–2 weeks and a full marketing site 3–5 weeks, depending on the number of pages and how quickly feedback comes back. You get a clear timeline before we start.

Yes — design and development happen together in Framer, so what you approve in the design is exactly what ships: same spacing, same motion, no hand-off surprises.

Absolutely. Most projects start with an audit of your current site — what to keep, what to drop, and where visitors are falling off — then a refresh of the identity, layout and content structure.

Two structured revision rounds are included at each stage. Because we review live Framer previews together, most clients need fewer — changes are quick to test and easy to compare.
